Questions

What is the median annual wage for Accountants in Chicago?

The OEWS May 2025 annual median for Accountants and Auditors in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN is $82,360.

What is the hourly median for Accountants in Chicago?

The OEWS May 2025 hourly median for Accountants and Auditors in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN is $39.60.

How many Accountants work in Chicago?

OEWS May 2025 estimates 41,360 wage-and-salary Accountants and Auditors in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN. Self-employed workers are excluded.

What is the location quotient for Accountants in Chicago?

The OEWS May 2025 location quotient is 0.98. Values above 1.00 mean Accountants and Auditors are more concentrated in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN than in the national occupational mix.

What is the mean annual wage for Accountants in Chicago?

The OEWS May 2025 annual mean for Accountants and Auditors in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN is $91,990.

How does Chicago's Accountants median compare to the other WageGrid metros?

Chicago's published OEWS May 2025 annual median ($82,360) is $760 lower than Austin ($83,120) and $17,010 lower than Seattle ($99,370). These are published medians minus published medians. WageGrid does not adjust for cost of living.

Does this wage include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS estimates cover wage-and-salary workers and exclude the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment figure.

Why is a wage cell blank?

BLS withholds some OEWS estimates for quality or confidentiality. WageGrid does not fill those cells.
